g.text: Half of Sindh's urban earners make under Rs 264,000 a year; the top tenth make over Rs 696,000
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: 2,644 earners aged 15-64 in urban Sindh with earnings > 0.
2 earners outside Rs 10,000-10,000,000 are excluded from the bars. Weighted by household weight (hhweight); lines are weighted percentiles.
